title: Nothing else on a staff record changes at release
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in to production (the live app, app.shopview.com) as an Admin of the production test account, at its test location, Trucks Hill 2.
  • Shortly before the release reached production, have a new staff member for this test on production, staff member A, active, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on, Billable set to Yes and Sales Representative on, enrolled at Trucks Hill 2 (written down with a screenshot of the staff record).
  • Shortly before the release reached production, have a second new staff member for this test on production, staff member B, on the built-in Service Advisor role, with Time Clock on, Billable set to No and Sales Representative off, with no work (written down with a screenshot), so one record left off is compared too.
custom_steps:
1. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  2. Close the Edit Staff Member window.
  3. Open staff member B's Edit Staff Member window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Technician is on.
  • Time Clock, Billable (Yes), Sales Representative (on) and the role (Parts Manager) are exactly as written down.

Step 2:

  • The window closes.

Step 3:

  • Technician is off.
  • Time Clock, Billable (No), Sales Representative (off) and the role (Service Advisor) are exactly as written down.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11884 (Story 6, Release day)

  • S6-R3: “Nothing else on any staff record changes: Time Clock, Billable, Sales Representative and roles stay as they are. A staff member turned on by the step is marked as updated at that moment, so software connected through the Public API that asks which staff changed picks up the new technician value on its next check (S5-R1). Staff left off are not marked.”
  • S6-R1 (c): “(c) has Billable on.”
  • S1-R9: “Billable and Sales Representative work exactly as today. Technician does not change, gray out or require either of them, and neither of them changes Technician.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs the before values taken on production shortly before the release reaches production; run on production after the release
